relationships.subject: Low-intensity pulsed ultrasound
relationships.evidence_quote: BBB opening endpoint was met with 90% of emitters showing BBB disruption on MRI after sonication.

relationships.subject: Blood-brain barrier
relationships.evidence_quote: demonstrated a 4–7 fold enhancement in carboplatin levels after sonication to disrupt the BBB

key_findings: Repeated BBB opening with a nine-emitter implantable ultrasound device plus carboplatin was safe in recurrent glioblastoma, with 90% of emitters giving BBB disruption.
Half-closure time of the ultrasound-disrupted BBB was about 1.3 h.
